# Function `pill_ui_kit::style::text_style_key`

```rust
pub(in style) fn text_style_key(style_name: &str) -> egui::TextStyle;
```

Visibility: `{'restricted': {'parent': 118, 'path': '::style'}}` · Source: `ui\pill_ui_kit\src\style.rs:304`

Returns the egui text-style key for a theme text style's name.

A name egui has no built-in key for becomes `TextStyle::Name`.
